description: The combos in a deck (id or name), any format, from Commander Spellbook's combo database (a copy refreshed with the card catalogue, not a live search). `in_list`: combos the deck's main list holds whole, most played first (up to 30; `in_list_total` says how many, counted among the 400 most played candidates read). `one_card_away`: combos the list misses one card of, most played first (up to 20; `more_one_card_away` when there are more), that card legal in the deck's format, in its colour identity and not in the deck: `missing.have` "owned" = the user owns a free copy (say `proxies` beside it when > 0, and name every deck in `shared_with`: those copies are borrowed), "to_buy" = its cheapest priced non-foil printing in `currency` (default USD; null when none is priced yet), and when `owned_claimed` > 0 name the decks in `claimed_by` that hold the user's copies. Each combo: its `cards` (`must_be_commander`: it works only from the command zone, so it counts only when that card leads the deck), `produces` (what it makes), `requires` (a kind of card it also needs, any one), `prerequisites` (the board it starts from), `mana_needed`, `steps`, `notes`, and `url`, its page on Commander Spellbook. Whenever you show a combo, credit Commander Spellbook by name with the link in `source`. `known` false: the combos are not loaded yet. Spellbook lists combos as written; check a combo's steps against the cards' text and rulings (card_detail) before you vouch for it. Changes nothing.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.
